_README: Female right forearm and hand bones from her torso CT (scripts/vhf_arm_bones_ct.py + vhf_arm_bones_ship.py); clipped by the field of view; hand grouped by planes. Derived data.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female 'Normal' CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 humerus label as the watershed marker.
left_arm: outside the CT field of view (not segmented)
